payload.title: Gateway: projection subscribe + initial snapshot + delta fan-out
payload.description: In apps/server/src/sync/gateway.ts, handle the client's existing 'projection' subscribe frame (the TS client already sends it — runtime.ts:463/886). On subscribe: register per-connection interest (mirror object/stream subscription bookkeeping) and immediately deliver an initial snapshot of the projection's current rows as a ProjectionDelta frame (FrameKind 19). Then call store.projections.setDeltaListener(notice => …) ONCE at gateway init and fan each ProjectionDeltaNotice out to connections subscribed to notice.projection, TENANT-SCOPED (only notice.tenantId subscribers). Handle unsubscribe + connection close cleanup. Test: two clients in the same tenant subscribed to a projection both receive a delta after a source write; a different-tenant client does not.
